mapper.delete: DELETE FROM PJT /* QueryID : com.demo.proworks.pjt.deletePjt */ WHERE PJT_ID = #{pjtId}
mapper.select: SELECT /* QueryID : com.demo.proworks.pjt.selectListPjt */ PJT_ID as pjtId, PJT_NAME as pjtName, PJT_ASI as pjtAsi, PJT_STATUS as pjtStatus, PJT_DETAIL as pjtDetail, CREATED_AT as createdAt, UPDATED_AT as updatedAt, PJT_ST as pjtSt, PJT_ET as pjtEt FROM ( SELECT S.*, CEIL((@ROWNUM := @ROWNUM + 1) / #{pageSize}) AS PAGE FROM ( SELECT p.* FROM PJT p JOIN PROJECT_USER_GROUP g ON p.PJT_ID = g.PJT_ID WHERE g.USER_ID = #{userId} ) S, (SELECT @ROWNUM := 0) TMP ) A WHERE PAGE = #{pageIndex}
SELECT /* QueryID : com.demo.proworks.pjt.selectListCountPjt */ COUNT(*) totcnt FROM PJT p JOIN PROJECT_USER_GROUP g ON p.PJT_ID = g.PJT_ID WHERE g.USER_ID = #{userId}
SELECT /* QueryID : com.demo.proworks.pjt.selectProjectProgress */ COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(task_rate), 0), 0) as progress FROM project_task WHERE pjt_id = #{pjtId} AND pt_task_id IS NULL
